preconditions.description: The height of the tree h is between 2 and 100,000.
The sequence a has h + 1 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 2 * 10**5 for i in range(h + 1))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence a is between 1 and 200,000.
The sum of all elements in the sequence a does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'perfect' or starts with 'ambiguous'.
If the output is 'perfect', there is exactly one tree matching the sequence.
If the output is 'ambiguous', there are multiple trees matching the sequence.
If the output is 'ambiguous', there are two additional lines describing the trees.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('ambiguous') implies (all(len(line.split()) == sum(a) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each tree description line has exactly the number of vertices specified by the sum of the sequence a.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('ambiguous') implies (all(int(parent) in range(sum(a)) or int(parent) == 0 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for parent in line.split()))
postconditions.description: Each parent in the tree description is either a valid vertex index or 0 (indicating the root).

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('ambiguous') implies (any(tree1 != tree2 for tree1, tree2 in zip(stdout.splitlines()[1:], stdout.splitlines()[2:])))
postconditions.description: The two tree descriptions are non-isomorphic.
